Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: One press. One action. Just when it becomes ready.
Description: A strict one-shot smart input buffer with adaptive local timing, hard cancellation rules, and automatic suspension around incompatible action plugins.
Changelog: Initial testing release: exact one-shot action buffering, 180 ms hard cap, adaptive local response timing, fail-closed cancellation, and live conflict suspension.
